description.value: Heritage Inn Hotel & Convention Centre is a full-service hotel and convention venue in Cranbrook, part of a Western Canadian chain with over 40 years of hospitality. The property features an on-site restaurant (Skylight Cafe) and lounge (Heritage Lounge), plus meeting and banquet facilities. Cranbrook sits in the heart of the Kootenays, making this a well-positioned overnight stop for cyclists touring the Columbia Valley or Crowsnest Pass routes.
